text:
[3. BOARD REPORTS]
Approve a Personal Services Agreement Between the City of Los Angeles and the
  Community Animal Medicine Project, Inc. to Continue to Provide Spay/Neuter and
  Related Veterinary Services at the Harbor Animal Services Center Spay/Neuter Clinic
  (Report No. 26-024).
summary: Approval of personal services agreement with Community Animal Medicine Project, Inc. to provide spay/neuter and veterinary services at Harbor Animal Services Center.
